# YomVezman 0.5.0 preview
App version 0.5.0 (5), for Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. This is a testing prerelease, not an App Store release.
- Saved full-screen opening preference, enabled by default. - Coordinated calendar reopening with Command-O. - Clearer Settings sections that preserve location drafts. - Updates preferences with optional startup checks; nothing installs silently. - Corrected Hebrew development-build update wording.
64 automated tests pass, including live integration. Developer ID signature, Apple notarization, stapling and Gatekeeper checks pass. Restart persistence, closed-calendar reopening and full-screen entry/manual exit passed isolated native checks. Complete minimized-window, menu-only/Dock recovery, keyboard accessibility, location-permission and network-recovery acceptance remain open; these are unverified paths, not confirmed defects. Keep Dock mode enabled for the most thoroughly exercised launch path.
From 0.4.0: Check for Updates → Update → Install Update → Install and Relaunch. Versions through 0.3.0 need one manual installation from the DMG. The owner-installed app has not been changed.
